administrativeOrAbsenteeIdentityClassifi.note: The report supplies an ABSENTEE measure for every source-named unit, but does not identify a separate statewide absentee or administrative reporting-unit class. Names are retained verbatim and are not reclassified.

countyCountDifferences.explanation: The workbook has one extra source row named ABSENTEE. It is an all-zero administrative placeholder with no separate participation identity and is classified non-geographic.
The workbook exposes 20 polling-place-labeled source rows while the participation report exposes 22 named precinct/local-unit identities. Count proximity is not used to infer a 22-to-20 crosswalk.
